opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Intended for academics in immediate danger who need temporary refuge to continue their work.
opportunities.summary: A rescue mission to support academics at immediate risk of imprisonment, injury or death, helping them to find temporary refuge and continue their work, most often via placements at UK universities and research institutions (and sometimes elsewhere). Fellowships help academics in danger to escape to a safe place where they can continue their work, either through postgraduate (e.g. PhD) study or postdoctoral research placements, typically for 2-3 years. Cara checks applications, helps negotiate placements, allocates additional funding where needed, and assists with visa and practical arrangements for the academic and accompanying family members.
